description: Change of Use from Use class E(c)(i)(Financial service) to Use Class E(b)(for the sale of food and drink principally to visiting members of the public where consumption of that food and drink is mostly undertaken on the premises,) with single storey rear extension, together with external extraction flue at rear.
decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: Location and Block Plan - L100Existing Site Plan- E101Existing Ground Floor Plan - E102Existing Roof Plan - E102.1Existing Elevations - E103Proposed Site Plan - P101Proposed ground Floor Plan P102 Rev AProposed Roof Plan - P102.1Proposed Elevations - P103Proposed Rear Extension - P104Proposed Extract System (Plan)- P105Proposed Extract System (notes)- P106Highway Safety Impact FormElectrostatic precipitation of particulate phase contaminants from commercial kitchen extractsNoise impact assessment report - kitchen extraction system Noise impact assessment - rear seating area Electrostatic Precipitation (ESP) Filter UnitElectrostatic Precipitation (ESP) range details.GigaBox centrifugal fans detailsTechnical Data Sheet for Cubical Exhaust UnitKitchen Extract - UV-O Range detailsSilencer details.Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

The external materials to be used in the construction of the development hereby permitted shall accord with the specification stated in the planning application form and approved plans submitted with the application unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure the that the development accords with the terms of the application and to ensure that the development has a satisfactory appearance

The development shall be carried out in accordance with the recommendations set out in the submitted Noise Impact Assessment. This shall include:o	Installation of glazing with a minimum performance of 28dB RW + Ctr; o	Installation of acoustic seals and door closers to the rear door.These measures shall be retained thereafter.Reason: To protect the living conditions of neighbouring occupiers.

All doors and windows to the rear extension shall remain closed during hours of operation, except for access and egress, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To minimise noise breakout and protect neighbouring amenity.

The approved cycle parking spaces shall be provided prior to the first use of the development and retained thereafter.Reason: To promote sustainable transport in accordance with London Plan Policy T5.

Servicing and deliveries shall be carried out in accordance with the details set out in the submitted information, and shall not take place outside the hours of 09:30-16:30, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To ensure safe and efficient servicing arrangements and to protect residential amenity
The refuse and recycling storage area as shown on the approved plans shall be provided prior to first occupation and retained thereafter.Reason: To ensure adequate waste management facilities.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification, the premises shall be used for sale of food or drink for consumption mostly on the premises within Class E(b) and for no other purpose unless written permission is otherwise granted. Reason: To help safeguard the amenities of the occupiers of nearby residential properties, and to ensure that the development complies with adopted parking and servicing standards.

The use hereby approved shall only operate between the hours of 11:00 - 23:30 hours from Sundays to Thursdays and 11:00 - 00:30 on Fridays and Saturdays, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To protect the amenities of surrounding residential occupiers.
